front.title: STB Cryptographic Parameters for Transport Layer Security (TLS) Protocol Version 1.3

author.organization: IM, Academy of Sciences of Belarus

abstract.t: This specification introduces a subset of STB (STandards of Belarus) cryptographic algorithms and defines their use in TLS 1.3. The document is self-contained, i.e., it fully describes the required STB algorithms. It can be used to develop STB-compliant TLS 1.3 implementations without referring to the original STB standards.
